item.title: Hotels in Mazatlán report minimal changes in reservations
item.description: Mazatlán’s hotel sector has seen changes in reservations for this weekend, although no mass cancellations have been reported, according to Francisca Cazares Oliveros, president of the Mazatlán National Chamber of Commerce, Services and Tourism.
